services_text1: Every detail handled, every decision guided — so you can simply step into a home you love.
services_text2: Your home should grow with you. Whether it's a kitchen that has never worked quite right, a bathroom you've been meaning to address for years, or a whole-home transformation you've been building toward — Bonnie brings the vision, the contractor relationships, and the oversight to make it exceptional.
services_text3: She manages the process start to finish — spatial planning, material selection, contractor communication, timeline management — so you are never juggling decisions alone. You step into the result.
services_text4: Building from the ground up or undertaking a significant remodel is one of the most personal things you'll ever do. Bonnie guides the creative direction from the very first blueprint to the final walk-through — every hard finish, every fixture, every architectural detail decided with intention.
services_text5: The result is a home where the bones are as beautiful as they are functional. Where the decisions made at the beginning serve the family living there for decades.
services_text6: A room is finished not when there is nothing left to add, but when there is nothing left to remove. Bonnie curates furniture, textiles, rugs, and art that tell your family's story — not her preferences, yours.
services_text7: Whether you are refreshing a single room or furnishing a newly built home from scratch, it culminates in a reveal day where every pillow is fluffed, every shelf is perfectly styled, and you fall in love with a space all over again.
services_text8: Bonnie believes deeply in the power of gathering. A home that welcomes — that makes people want to linger, to come back, to feel held by the space — is one of the greatest gifts you can give your family and friends.
services_text9: Her seasonal styling and holiday readiness services ensure your home is prepared to receive the people you love. You focus on the memories. She handles everything else.
services_text10: From the first conversation to the final walk-through, Bonnie guides every step so the journey is as beautiful as the destination.
services_text11: It starts with a relaxed call — your wishlist, your lifestyle, your dreams for the space. No pressure. Just listening.
services_text12: Bonnie builds a curated mood board and design direction tailored entirely to your family — not a template, not a trend. Yours.
